geometry.coordinateSystem: source logical pixel local x in [0,1), increasing left-to-right; y is uniform

activeFill.meaning: all of the logical period is assigned to three equal rectangles; this is not a measured fill factor

inactiveGap.phase: trailing interval [activeFill,1) if a future measured fill is supplied

uncertainty.selectedOrderConfidence: moderate; CGB-specific secondary observation plus independent RGB-subpixel prior art and Sharp-family RGB filters
uncertainty.allowedFutureCandidateRange: requires a provenance-bearing calibrated OEM CGB macro/microscope capture; no current numeric range is released

decomposition.modelSpace: unclipped linear sRGB D65 converted from WS5 absolute relative-reflectance XYZ
decomposition.energyNormalization: with activeFill=1, each stripe has period mean 1/3 and the factor 3 recovers every input channel exactly over a complete period
decomposition.physicalClaim: energy-preserving model-space subpixel presentation only; not a recovered microscopic color-filter spectral decomposition

surface.inactiveRegionPolicy: the declared WS1 code-zero black is available for a future measured gap, but gap area is zero in the accepted model
surface.reflectorPolicy: bare measured panel only; the aggregate reflector/MRS behavior at 45 degree illumination and 0 degree normal view is already present in WS1/WS5
surface.frontLens: disabled and separately bypassable if a future target-specific layer is introduced

visibleSurfaceGrain.reason: no calibrated spatial power spectrum or energy bound exists, and individual MRS facets must not be rendered

integration.method: analytic integral of periodic rectangular indicators over each host-pixel footprint

limits: No numeric CGB inactive gap, fill factor, notch, bus mask, or surface texture is claimed.
The accepted aperture does not alter WS1 color, WS4 motion state, or WS5 reflected exposure when averaged over a full source period.
Actual GPU readback and Shader compilation remain WS8/WS9.
